author: Aaij, Roel and others
title: Measurement of the $\Omega_c^0$ and $\Xi_c^0$ baryon lifetimes using hadronic $b$-baryon decays
abstract: The lifetimes of the $\Omega_c^0$ and $\Xi_c^0$ baryons are measured using a $pp$ collision dataset collected by the LHCb experiment, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of $9~\rm{fb^{-1}}$. The charm baryons are produced in the fully reconstructed decay chains $\Omega_b^- \to \Omega_c^0 (\to pK^-K^-\pi^+)\,\pi^-$ and $\Xi_b^- \to \Xi_c^0 (\to pK^-K^-\pi^+)\,\pi^-$. The measurement uses topologically and kinematically similar $B^- \to D^0(\to K^-K^+\pi^-\pi^+)\,\pi^-$ decays for normalisation. The measured lifetimes are $\tau_{\Omega_c^0} = 276.3 \pm 19.4\;(\rm{stat}) \pm 1.8\;(\rm{syst}) \pm 0.7\;(\tau_{D^0})\;\rm{fs}$ and $\tau_{\Xi_c^0} = 149.2 \pm 2.5\;(\rm{stat}) \pm 0.9\;(\rm{syst}) \pm 0.4\;(\tau_{D^0})\;\rm{fs}$, consistent with previous measurements performed by the LHCb experiment. The results are combined with previous LHCb measurements to give $\tau_{\Omega_c^0} = 274.8 \pm 10.5$ fs and $\tau_{\Xi_c^0} = 150.7 \pm 1.6$ fs.
